comment: Scene manifest: the scene chips and ?scene=<id> resolve against this list. 'base' is relative to this file; point it at an absolute URL (a CDN or bucket) to host scenes elsewhere — the host must send CORS headers, and byte ranges for .nxs4 streaming. 'cam' overrides the scene's stored view (yaw/pitch/roll in radians, dolly in scene radii); 'limits' clamps yaw/pitch/dolly.
